import math

outer_diameter = 66.3
inner_diameter = 30.0
thickness = 13.3
tab_width = 15.6
tab_height = 20.0
hole_diameter = 3.9
hole_count = 8
hole_radius = (outer_diameter / 2) - 5.0
chamfer_size = 0.5
